# TPC-Havoc Q11_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  ps.ps_partkey,
  SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS value
FROM partsupp AS ps
INNER JOIN supplier AS s
  ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
INNER JOIN nation AS n
  ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
  n.n_name = 'GERMANY'
GROUP BY
  ps.ps_partkey
HAVING
  SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > (
    SELECT
      SUM(ps2.ps_supplycost * ps2.ps_availqty) * 0.0100000000
    FROM partsupp AS ps2
    INNER JOIN supplier AS s2
      ON ps2.ps_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey
    INNER JOIN nation AS n2
      ON s2.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
    WHERE
      n2.n_name = 'GERMANY'
  )
ORDER BY
  value DESC
```
